title: Tortilla Española
description: A traditional Spain dish made with potato, yellow onion, chicken egg. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Cook the thinly sliced potatoes and onions slowly in olive oil over medium-low heat until tender, not crisp. Drain off excess oil.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Return the egg-and-potato mixture to a lightly oiled skillet, cook gently until the base sets, then turn with a plate and finish the other side; the center should be set for a safe egg dish.
